written: 2026-10-09, after the inventory and the baseline probe on ede8d329, before any product change
binding_rule: An unnamed regular-pyramid claim ('hình chóp tứ/tam giác đều' with no apex/base named in the givens) is bound to the program's single solid ONLY when every point the text names has coordinates in the text (no point named at all included). Then the labelling of vertices carries no meaning the text did not fix, and every bound claim is VERIFIED (C1 template on the program values / C0 predicate), never trusted. C0: a contradiction needs that NO pyramid reading of the solid satisfies the claim. Texts that name points without coordinates ('AB = 4, SA = 3', 'cạnh bên SA') are left unchanged: the text does not say which point is the apex (scope 'unchanged').
c1_rows_rule: 47 rows = the `unnamed_everywhere` variant of ../c0-whole-solid-reader/diagnostics/probe_c1_equivalence.py (both regular-pyramid corpora, same LLM-style program as the canonical row). corpus_label = the corpus's preregistered label for the canonical text; class from baseline_ede8d329 vs corpus_label; scope bind ⇒ expect = corpus_label (re-derived from the stated dimensions by oracle.py); scope unchanged ⇒ expect = baseline outcome.
